# Native Studio material fixtures

Exported with SerializationService from Roblox Studio 0.746.0.7461264 during the material round-trip suite. Files contain controlled test geometry and diagnostic texture references owned by test creator 7255061823. No user production scene is included.

The generator, Studio controller, upload receipts, captures and comparison workflow are documented in `tools/material_parity/README.md`. Binary files are retained intact to exercise current native Content/Vector2/property serialization, not a hand-written fixture format. Shader unit tests mock images and do not upload or require network access.
